fichas.title: Public Transport: Stops and Stations
fichas.summary: Design guidance for railway, tram, and other public-transport stops and stations. Covers central and side platform layouts, platform length and width, stairs and escalators, lifts, tram stops, dynamic stops, and platform surfacing. The diagrams include stair layouts and platform cross-sections; a table gives minimum lift sizes by passenger load or potential hindrance.
